== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The original starts from a battleground system with a delivered site and the variable Effect allowance. The earlier remastered full face retains the Used cycle and changes the setup to a battleground site, delivered system, icon cap and three Effects. The issuer dates the Starting-only replacement to 25 June 2007. The December 2007 capture dates the surviving older full face.
